headline: There aren’t AirPods with cameras yet and I hope it stays that way
summary: Apple's September event unveiled new products but no camera-equipped AirPods. The author expresses relief about the absence of camera AirPods. New AirPods 5 now feature active noise cancellation.

headline: The black iPhone Pro returns
summary: Apple reintroduces a black model to its iPhone Pro lineup. Last year's iPhone 17 Pro offered bold colors but no black option. Fans can now get a classic black (or dark gray) iPhone 18 Pro.

headline: The incomplete history of Duo devices
summary: Apple's new iPhone Duo is their first foldable, joining Samsung and Google in the market. The 'Duo' name itself is not new to tech products. This device marks a significant step for Apple into the foldable phone space.

headline: Automattic CEO Matt Mullenweg placed on leave
summary: WordPress.com owner Automattic's CEO, Matt Mullenweg, is on paid leave. Mullenweg alleges the CFO conspired with board members for his removal. The investigation follows a report by 404 Media.

headline: The People v. Gorilla Grodd Set Video Shows DC Villain Singing Backstreet Boys
summary: BTS footage shows DC villain Gorilla Grodd singing Backstreet Boys. He performs "As Long as You Love Me" in an a cappella group. This is from the set of DC Studios' The People v. Gorilla Grodd.

headline: The Practical Acer 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale For Just $39.99 at Best Buy
summary: Acer's 16" 1080p portable USB monitor is on sale for $39.99. It's ideal as a secondary laptop screen. The monitor also serves as a portable display for consoles like the Nintendo Switch 2.

headline: If I Were to Buy a (Near) 100" TV Right Now, I Would Get TCL's QM8L SQD Mini-LED TV Over OLED
summary: The author recommends TCL's QM8L SQD Mini-LED TV for large displays. They argue it surpasses OLED TVs for nearly 100-inch sizes. This Mini-LED option is also considered better than home theater projectors.

headline: Valorant Cheater Using Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur Skin Banned After Viral Video Sparks Backlash Against Riot's Anti-Cheat
summary: A Valorant cheater with an 'Evil' Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin was banned. The ban followed a viral video exposing their disruptive gameplay. This incident sparked criticism against Riot's anti-cheat system.

headline: England's mayors to be given power to introduce tourist tax
summary: English mayors are expected to gain power to introduce a tourist tax. The government will outline how local leaders can impose levies. This tax would apply to overnight stays in their regions.

headline: Iran war will not end until after November US elections, says Trump
summary: Former President Trump states the Iran war won't end before the US elections. He also predicts oil prices won't drop until after the November vote. These comments were made to reporters.

headline: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
summary: Police have launched a criminal investigation into Reform UK donations. This follows a broadcast report by Channel 4 News. The new inquiry is integrated with existing investigations into other donations.

headline: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
summary: The transport secretary stated the recent air traffic failure was avoidable. Heidi Alexander has ordered a full investigation into the glitch. The incident caused over 2,000 flight cancellations.
